record.field: Employee contracts board for workforce agreements: running and draft counts, new and expired contracts, average wage, contract coverage of the active workforce, overdue endings, start trends and department/type analytics. Workforce figures only count contracts of active employees, while the overdue and open-ended alerts keep the whole portfolio. Requires Contracts.
